descFull: One command turns a DGX Spark (64 or 128 GB) or an ASUS Ascent GX10 into a private AI server: nine measured, pinned lanes (Qwen3.8 27B and Flash up to 1M tokens, Ornith, Nemotron, Kolibri, images, video with sound), OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and a local cockpit on a laptop or a phone. Nothing leaves the box.
